objective: Publish the Linux driver-layer architecture and a reviewable boundary for SocketCAN, IRQ, DMA and recovery work.
acceptance: the architecture identifies Linux subsystem boundaries and driver lifecycle rollback
SocketCAN, IRQ, DMA, locking and buffer ownership rules are explicit
the document distinguishes the wbcan software test device from physical hardware evidence
future CAN FD, UART/SPI, GPIO, DMA and interrupt work has stated prerequisites and stop conditions
stop_conditions: a physical controller model or register contract is required
the change would require firmware, interface or robot-control writes
a planning value would be presented as hardware performance evidence
